name: ui11_03_slots_return_nothing
description: Conformance test 3: neither CloseSecondaryMenu (slot 59) nor CloseTertiaryMenu (slot 60) produces a value - a caller must not read EAX. ui-windows 3.3 corrects vtables.tsv, which records slot 60 as via-call; the body at 0x007E5E90 ends in a plain ret after pop ecx; pop esi, so the channel is none (void) and the confidence is high. Slot 3 does produce a value (eax), slot 0 is al only.
